en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a colored illustration of a garden party scene, with tables and chairs set among landscaped flowerbeds and tall trees. In the background, a building is partially visible, and several people in period dress are sitting and conversing. There appears to be a statue on the left side. The text at the top reads 'Gebirgsausflugsort u. Sommerfrische Sennhütte-Burgwaldhof bei Bad Pyrmont (Fernruf 50)' indicating a mountain excursion site and summer retreat near Bad Pyrmont. The lower right corner reads 'Gartenpartie' (garden party). The reverse side features handwritten German text and address information, as well as printed text stating 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
